result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that renders mostly well. A few minor visual issues exist around content truncation and inconsistent styling of the favorite (heart) icons.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is cut off at the right edge, showing incomplete text.
issues.suggestion: Ensure horizontally scrollable cards show a clear peek/edge fade and truncate long names with an ellipsis in a controlled way, or reduce card width so text is legible.

issues.description: The heart (favorite) icons on the two 'Popular right now' cards have inconsistent styling — the first has a white/transparent background outline while the second appears on a darker filled circle, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon background, size, and contrast treatment across all cards for a consistent look.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' pizza card is missing its title, rating, and metadata row (unlike the ramen card above it), making the listing appear incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Verify the card data loads fully; add the restaurant name, rating, delivery time, and cuisine label beneath the image as with the other cards.
